subject: general
question: In a certain code, TAPE is coded as WDSH and SACK is coded as VDFN. What is the code for MANY?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/30dbf680205b2ac5ef3c42da1ffec8619642030da36e21c43297a3224c70e079.png] 

The logic followed here is,

**TAPE is coded as WDSH,**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7e3f4ae5a0aca7f5862e04e6c1102a2bbadbb1aeecd7bdc2220dcf49f0964fcf.png] 

**SACK is coded as VDFN,**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5cb8a646b480807c758bce02bf7aaa9e4d06f7e2ad698bbf334598d88dd1ceba.png] 

Similarly,

**'MANY' can be coded as,**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/cf74ecda65d03fecac92431c9b431acb20c2b6f1f89f98539874041c0f0187ce.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is **"****PDQB"**.
